first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Capture shared Java startup state before entry (verification pending)
commits.body:
A separately scoped native check can initialize a root on the subject JVM before entry and capture the static state of every application class initialized with it in one object table. Class hashes, transitive fields, aliases and eager timing qualify the state. Opaque reads, absent supertypes and overlapping independent captures stop the check. The original single-class scope still compares startup against independent JVMs. Candidate JVM replays apply the same requested initialization and process settings.

Physical JVM and native regression tests checked the cross-class array mutation and the difference made by writing a static after startup. Negative controls exercised opaque reads, overlap, malformed references and changes to the state digest. All 47 changed test groups passed, the inventory lint passed and example 355 replayed both revisions across all 21 inputs. A capped probe on the original fixed Avro converter passed the shared Accessor registration and reached Schema.SCHEMA_RESERVED. Job 20261121-125740-check-avro-converter-after-joint-schema repeats the separately registered full claim on the pinned 124-entry classpath.

commits.summary: Carry opaque Java references through constructors (verification pending)
commits.body:
Keep an unavailable reference abstract when a joint JVM snapshot supplies it. Real application constructors can store it, throw or overwrite it. Inspecting it, calling through it or entering an unsupported operation still ends the proof. Paired call reuse declines these values. The native checker and concrete interpreter also execute the selected JDK bytecode for a freshly constructed ConcurrentLinkedQueue and its empty sentinel.

Physical JVM, native and interpreter regressions covered mutation, exception and read-before-overwrite controls, two distinct empty queues and their null head reads. All 8 selected test groups passed, including 58 Rust test binaries, and the test inventory lint passed. A capped run of the original Avro converter got through Schema construction, then reached Hadoop Configuration in WritableComparator while constructing BytesWritable. Job 20261121-131508-check-the-original-avro-converter-throug repeats the previously frozen claim on the same shared startup digest.

commits.summary: Bind ordered JVM startup roots on one heap (verification pending)
commits.body:
Initialize all requested application roots in order in the same subject JVM. Class digests and ordered roots qualify a common state digest, and both sides of a pair retain their own class identities. A Unix-root working-directory option measures the process and JVM bases and binds lexical File resolution. Canonical paths still require filesystem evidence. Independent witness JVMs use the requested directory and initialization order.

The original Avro parent and fix independently produced the same 197-class, 696-object startup state for Schema followed by BytesWritable. Ten separate claims retain the original inputs and public entry points under that condition. A capped native run reached ByteBuffer.wrap in the fixed converter and a separate factory run reached JobConf startup. Job 20261121-132242-bind-avro-and-hadoop-startup-before-the repeats three registered claims. JVM/native regressions covered root ordering, digest changes, lexical paths and canonical-path refusal. Example 355 replayed all 21 inputs on both revisions. 46 of 47 selected groups passed together. The trace-index group that compared concurrent jj views then passed all 105 tests alone.

commits.summary: Verify absolute bounds on wrapped byte buffers (verification pending)
commits.body:
Run the original ByteBuffer.wrap overloads and real heap-buffer accessors. The selected JDK performs the signed index check. For the known Temurin 21 and 25 bounds formatters, four image class hashes bind the formatting path and the checker runs the actual no-argument exception factory. Buffer position, backing-array aliases, capacity and the constructor's invalid-range behavior remain visible.

Physical JVM and native tests passed on JDK 21.0.13 and 25.0.5, including negative and excluded indices, null exception messages, invalid slices and writes shared with the original array. The 28 selected groups and the Avro example validator passed. On the original 124-entry closures the capped checker proved the fixed nested converter for all 21 admitted inputs and found the parent at code=1. Job 20261121-133632-prove-avro-buffer-bounds-and-replay-the repeats both and submits that native candidate to an ambient original JVM. Job 20261121-133632-measure-every-avro-factory-obligation-wi records every factory companion and the additional three-root JobConf scope.

commits.summary: Record Avro's native buffer proof and original parent counterexample
commits.body:
On the original Avro parent a one-byte writable shrunk to zero exposes its byte. The fixed public nested converter rejects absolute index zero, retains capacity one and leaves position zero. The native checker established the fixed contract across all 21 capacity/length pairs with the 197-class startup snapshot and refuted the parent. An independent JVM admitted selector 1 on the original parent without preinitialization and reproduced the violation. This takes original-scope native decisions from 36 to 37 of 46 across the six primary PRs. The fixed establishment retains its explicit startup condition.

All five runner results and 287 output hashes were checked against committed collector data, the original 124-entry closures, checker identity, frozen claims and JVM observations. The direct proof and ambient witness steps passed in 23.9 seconds. Four diagnostic jobs preserved the earlier stops and all nine open factory attempts, including Collections.newSetFromMap after JobConf startup. The campaign score and all 20 report links were checked, example 355 passed validation, and the results index was regenerated for all 973 collected jobs. All 66 default test groups passed while the last collector record arrived. An additional default run on the committed evidence supplies the final coverage record.
